docket_entries.description: SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF MAR-16-2021 - CONTINUED FOR PROGRESS REPORT TO APR-28-2021 AT 10:00 AM IN DEPT. 506. PLAINTIFF RAYAN MADJIDI IS PRESENT. DEFENDANT CORAZON TRISSEL IS PRESENT. COURT DISCLOSURE REGARDING CAMPAIGN CONTRIBUTIONS IS MADE. PARTIES AGREE TO A SETTLEMENT AMOUNT OF $330.00.
